payout_quote: Complete a net deposit of $500 during the promotion period, and you will receive $30 in NVDA stock, as fractional shares of NVDA. After receiving your free stocks, you'll need to maintain average assets of $500 or more for 60 days to unlock these stocks... Promotion Period: January 1, 2026, 00:00 ET - December 31, 2026, 23:59 ET. ... Deposit bonuses are only eligible for those who deposit via ACH, WIRE or instant transfer... Within 5 trading days following the conclusion of the 60-day waiting period, your free stocks will be added to your account and available for trading... Customers may hold or sell awarded stocks once credited to their accounts. The value from sale of the stock can be withdrawn or used to buy other eligible securities in the account. (Official moomoo.com US help center terms, fetched 2026-09-23)
timing: Stocks tradable within 5 trading days after the 60-day average-asset hold; sale proceeds officially withdrawable per terms
eligibility: US residents 18+ with valid SSN; new Moomoo Financial customers (no account opened before Jan 1, 2026, or existing account with no prior deposit); net deposit via ACH/WIRE/instant transfer that settles by Dec 31, 2026
steps: Make a net deposit of $500+ via ACH or instant transfer (not ACAT/FOP)
Claim the $30 NVDA stock reward in the app
Maintain average daily assets of $500+ for 60 days starting the day after claiming
Stocks unlock within 5 trading days after the 60-day period; sell or keep
catches: $500 of YOUR OWN money must sit in the account for 60 days to earn $30 - that's the price of admission; withdraw below $500 during the freeze and you lose the reward.
ACAT transfers from another brokerage and FOP transfers do NOT count as qualifying deposits.
The $30 is fractional NVDA shares valued at the claim-time price - NVDA can fall during the 60-day lock, and fractional shares can't be transferred out.
Requires SSN and full brokerage KYC.
If the reward doesn't credit, you must contact customer service within 14 business days.
moomoo can adjust or discontinue the incentive at its discretion.
biggest_catch: $500 of your own money is locked up for 60 days to earn $30 in NVDA stock that can lose value while you wait - and ACAT transfers from another broker don't count.
